flights.question: Do you sell flights?
flights.answer: No – flights are booked by each guest. We recommend flying to Toulouse, Montpellier or Barcelona.

included.question: What is included in the price?
included.answer: Accommodation, all meals including drinks, local transport and a Norwegian host. See each trip for the full list.

privateGroup.answer: Yes – we offer tailor-made private trips for friends, wine clubs, associations and companies. Contact us for a quote.

payment.answer: 25% deposit when booking. The balance is due 30 days before departure.

age.question: Are the trips suited to older travellers?
age.answer: Yes – the pace is relaxed and suits active adults from 50 and up.

fitness.title: Physical fitness, mobility and health
fitness.intro: The trip normally has a comfortable pace, but along the way you may encounter:

fitness.accommodation: The organiser will, as far as is practical and safe, seek to make reasonable adjustments, but cannot guarantee that all activities are accessible to everyone.
fitness.safety: For safety reasons, the organiser may refuse or limit your participation in certain activities if your physical condition or state of health makes it unsafe for yourself, other participants or suppliers. In such cases, a refund is normally not given for the activity in question.
fitness.contact: If you are unsure whether the trip is right for you, we encourage you to contact the organiser in advance – the aim is for all guests to feel safe and well looked after.

privateTrips.title: Private trips
privateTrips.description: For friends who want to travel properly. Wine clubs who want to meet the producers. Associations with a shared passion. Groups who want something entirely their own.
privateTrips.cta: Talk to us about a tailored trip

wineClub.title: Wine club in Minervois
wineClub.description: A tailor-made trip for your club – across the appellations Limoux, Corbières, Minervois, La Livinière and St-Chinian. Visits to producers we know personally: tastings in cellars and vineyards, lunch among the vines and long evenings with wines you'll remember. We arrange the programme, transport and accommodation – you choose group size, level and pace.

birthday.title: Celebration
birthday.description: A 40th, 50th, 60th or 70th birthday – or another milestone that deserves more than cake in the office. We create a celebration in Languedoc where your guests can simply be guests: good food and wine, shared experiences and a pace that suits the person being celebrated. Family, friends or colleagues – we arrange accommodation, programme and details so you can be present for the celebration.

business.title: Business & teams
business.description: Gatherings that work – without flip charts and PowerPoint in a meeting room. We build a programme where Languedoc does the heavy lifting: shared experiences, good food and space for conversations that actually move things forward.

corporate.title: Corporate trip with purpose
corporate.description: Languedoc as a setting away from the office – for the leadership team, the whole department or a tight startup core. Shared experiences that build trust, culture and direction: vineyard visits, food and local producers, guided conversations in small groups and time for strategy without interruption – plus evenings where hierarchy loosens its grip. We tailor the programme and logistics to what you want to achieve: stronger collaboration, celebrating a milestone, kick-off or re-start.

business.cta: Talk to us about a corporate trip

about.title: Two Frenchmen hidden in Norwegian bodies
about.intro: Over a combined 18 years in Languedoc, friends and acquaintances kept asking us the same question: «Why don't you organise trips for others?» We laughed a little and replied «not quite the right time for that». But the idea stuck – and the desire to share this place grew stronger than we could ignore.
about.elisabeth: Elisabeth is a teacher by background, a tour leader and a cook in practice. She remembers what everyone wants in their glass without asking twice, and has a natural gift for gathering people around a table in a way that helps them relax, laugh and feel they are exactly where they should be. With Elisabeth, no guest is left to fend for themselves.
about.morten: Morten also works with wine and has come to know the region the way only those who have truly let themselves be absorbed by a place can. With Languedoc as his home ground, he knows the producers by name, which cellar hides the vintages nobody knows about, and which restaurant in which village serves the best meal on a Tuesday in May. He brings that knowledge with him – and shares it gladly.
about.together: Together we offer something few travel organisers can: genuine access. Not guided tours behind a rope, but conversations around the producers' own tables and experiences that happen because we know the people behind them.
about.closing: The best trips are not about seeing as much as possible. They are about coming home with a feeling that you were truly somewhere.
about.signoff: Live like a local. Be treated like a guest.

languedoc.title: Languedoc
languedoc.subtitle: Authentic, warm and a little less polished.
languedoc.intro: Languedoc is something distinct – a region that has spent the last fifty years not preparing for tourists, but cultivating the land and living well. Here you find villages, vineyards, market halls, coast, mountains and architecture with strong stories – without everything feeling packaged like a tourist brochure.

where.title: Where we are
where.body: Our base is in Minervois – one of Languedoc's most exciting wine regions, between the Mediterranean and the Montagne Noire mountain range. The Pyrenees lie to the south. In Minervois, everything is within reach.

stay.title: Where you stay
stay.body: We are a company that places great emphasis on personal follow-up and quality. Our trips are run in small groups, where closeness makes room for genuine experiences. We have two authentic stone houses from the 1800s – carefully restored to combine historic charm with modern comfort. Original tile floors and hand-forged hinges alongside comfortable beds. When we say you live like a local, it is almost an understatement – here you stay both more spaciously and more comfortably than is usual in the area.

hirondelle.title: L'Hirondelle
hirondelle.body: A classic maison maître from 1820, with high ceilings and an elegance that lives in the walls.

villaBelle.title: Villa Belle
villaBelle.body: A solid stone house from 1850 with thick stone walls, generous shared spaces and a garden that invites long evenings.

stay.closing: Both properties have a pool, garden and patio – and both sit right in the everyday life we want you to experience.

languedoc.statement: Languedoc is where France is still not finished surprising you.
